contexts.text: The least of thought with man is more perceptible to the Angels than its greatest.
Heaven does not consist in desiring to be the least in order to be the greatest. HH 408.
He wanted to be the least, in order to become the greatest in Heaven. AC 6393:4. SE 1302.
These are they who are meant by the least, who become the greatest in the Lord's Kingdom. Explained.
The Lord scarcely wanted to be even the least.
They did not know that heavenly delight... is the delight of humiliation, and of the affection of serving others; thus to want to be, not the greatest, but the least; as the Lord teaches in .
The spiritual man seems to himself to have his life in humiliation, and in being the least...
Under Great, see this reference. DLW 269. DLW 275:2. DLW 285:3. SE 5775. AE 1055:2.
For man is a Heaven in the least form. AC 6013:2. DLW 203. DLW 231.
The youngest () = him who is born after all. Explained.
The internal man is a Heaven in the least form; and the external man is a world in the least form.
Heavenly bliss is... to want to serve others, and to be the least, as the Lord teaches in .
Such is the effigy of the least things of his will.
That this (evil) is in the least things of his thought and will, is manifestly evident from the sphere...
For everyone in an angelic Society is a Heaven in the least form. HH 51, General article.
Is a Church in the least form.
In Heaven... he is called the least who has no power and wisdom, and wants to have no power and wisdom, from himself, but from the Lord; such a least one has the greatest happiness...
Then becomes a Heaven in the least form.
That the Divine in the greatest and least things is the same. General article. DLW 223:end. DLW 300.
Under Degree, see this reference. DLW 223. DLW 226.
The perfection of the created universe is from the likeness of the generals and the particulars, or of the greatest and least things, as to these degrees...
The reason there are degrees of both kinds also in the leasts of all things, is that the spiritual Sun is the one only substance from which are all things.
Substances and matters... in their leasts.
Is a Hell in the least form. DP 296:13.
As to his mind... man is either a Heaven or a Hell in the least form.
What to want to be the least means. Explained.
That he is greatest in Heaven who is least. Explained.
They then wanted to call themselves the least. But I replied...
The thought of God... as of nature in its leasts, closes Heaven.

In the least point (wisdom and love) are one... for that which proceeds from the Sun also is the Sun in the leasts, and thence universally in the whole... There is not meant a point and least of space; for this has no existence in the Divine...
